SPECIFICATION FOR 
ADAPTER FOR TERMINAL DEVICES, ARTIFICIAL LIMBS 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements of adapter for terminal devices. 

2. Material — The spindle and disc of the adapter shall be manufactured from carbon 



steel 



conforming,to IS: 7283-1974 'Specification for h,ot-rolled bars for production of bright bars' or 
designation 11C10S25 of IS : 4431-1978 ' Specification' for carbon and carbon-manganese free-cutting 
steels ( first revision ) ' and Type of IS : 513-1973' v Specification for cold rolled carbon steel sheets 
( second revision ) \ respectively. 

3. Types — The adapter shall be of two types as shown in Fig 1 and 2. 

4. Shape and Dimensions — The general shape and dimensions of the adapter shall be as given 
in Fig. 1 or Fig. 2.

IS: 4534- 1980 

5. Manufacture, Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The spindle shall be manufactured by turning and the disc shall be pressed out of carbon steel 
plate (see 2). The holes in the disc shall be clean and free from burrs and shall be spaced 
evenly as shown in Fig. 1 and 2. The internal threads shall be cut accurately and shall be smooth, 
clean and free from burrs. The adapter shall be free from pits, cracks, scales, seams and other 
surface flaws. The adapter shall be plated chromium over nickel and the plating shall conform to 
Grade 3 of IS : 1068-1968 ' Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron 
and steef ( first revision ) \ 

6. Test 

6.1 The spindle of the adapter shall be firmly gripped in a suitable bench vice The disc of the 
adapter shall be suitably loaded with a dead load of 150 kgf for a period of 3 minutes. On removing 
the load the joint between the disc and the spindle shall not have loosened or developed cracks. 

7- Marking — The adapters shall be clearly and legibly marked with the manufacturer's name, 
initials or recognized trade-mark. 

7-1 ISi Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing —The adapters shall be packed in the manner as agreed to between the purchaser and 
the supplier. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Terminal devices for artificial limbs are working accessories to be fitted into the dress or 
working arm of an amputee of the upper extremity. The adapter is used to fit these terminal devices 
to the artificial arm. Interchangeabiiity is an essential aspect for the manufacture of adapters 
because the same adapter has to receive a variety of terminal devices and has also to be capable 
of being fitted into any working arm. This revision incorporates an alternate design of the 
adapter.
